name: Alpha Strike
strategy: Deliver powerful opening attacks and exploit the first moments of an Engagement.

commands.name: First Strike Orders
commands.effect: One friendly Unit within Short of friendly Headquarters gains Accurate 2 on its next Attack against an enemy it has not previously attacked this battle.

commands.name: Opening Volley
commands.effect: One friendly Unit gains +3 Attacks on its first ranged Attack of the battle.

commands.name: Shock Assault
commands.effect: One friendly Unit that Charged this Round gains +2 Attacks on its first Engagement Attack this Combat Phase.

commands.name: Opening Barrage
commands.effect: One friendly Unit gains +2 Attacks on its first Attack against a target it has not previously attacked this battle.

commands.name: Ferocious Opening
commands.effect: One friendly Unit gains Accurate 2 and Critical 1 on its first Engagement Attack against a target it has not previously attacked this battle.

doctrineIdentity: Front-loaded damage and decisive first contact. Alpha Strike is less effective during prolonged engagements because many of its bonuses depend on making initial attacks.
